name: Azure Database for PostgreSQL
line: Run managed PostgreSQL with vector search and scheduled SQL.

free.text: 750 B1MS hours/month, 32 GB; stopped server restarts after 7 days

cells.regions: Multiple Azure regions; availability varies by option

sql.math: 730 hours × $0.178 an hour for compute, plus 32 GiB × $0.115 for storage. Extras and tax are not included.
Even when idle, a running server bills 730 hours of compute and 32 GiB of storage. Extras and tax are not included.

jobs.math: Scheduled SQL jobs use the same server resources. Whether the required run time and CPU fit is not confirmed.
